subject: superpowers
tagline: Complete software-development methodology for coding agents built on composable skills plus bootstrap instructions that force the agent to use them.

capabilities.name: SessionStart bootstrap
capabilities.description: Injects using-superpowers body so the agent must invoke skills before any action.

capabilities.name: SDO skill descriptions
capabilities.description: Description is trigger-only; workflow summaries are forbidden because agents skip the body.

capabilities.name: Subagent-driven development
capabilities.description: Fresh implementer per task, file-only briefs, 5-round fix loop with breaker, plan-scoped ledger.

capabilities.name: TDD iron law
capabilities.description: Red/green/refactor enforced as a skill, tested with pressure scenarios.

capabilities.name: Skill TDD authoring
capabilities.description: Skills are written only after a failing pressure-scenario baseline.

capabilities.name: Multi-host plugin pack
capabilities.description: Same skills packaged for Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Pi.

unique_selling_points: Process plugin that forces skill use via hook, not hope
Ledger + file handoff designed after compaction re-dispatched finished tasks
Zero-dep; domain skills rejected from core

limitations.description: No org-chart, budgets, or plugin marketplace of its own
Depends on host context files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md) for identity
